verdict.rationale: Helicone publishes a formal OpenAPI/swagger spec and REST API reference pages, and separately offers a 'Playground' for testing/iterating on prompts in its UI, suggesting some interactive tooling exists. However, there is no direct evidence of a Swagger-UI-style interactive reference page where a user can execute runnable request examples against the API from the docs themselves. Missing for 10: confirmation of an actual 'try it out' runnable console in the API reference docs, and evidence of code-sample generation across languages.
